name: Re-cut of the 5C spot
note: Apple's own advertisement, re-cut to different music. Internal evaluation only — their footage, a commercial master; nothing built from this may be published.
format_note: The source's own geometry, so the comparison against Apple's cut is like for like. A named format ('16:9') would upscale and resample.
preserve_order_note: Re-TIME, do not re-order. The source is a finished film whose shot order carries the argument -- plastic becomes a shell becomes a phone, red to green to yellow to blue. Choosing shots by fit shuffled that and the result was not close to the original. The music still decides when to cut and for how long; the editor keeps the order.
